analysis.title: GS U.S. Industrials & Materials pivotal moments ... 3 Nov 2026
key_insights: MMM announced after the close a resolution of AFFF personal injury litigation: $7.35bn pre-tax nominal commitment over nine years, present value $5.8bn, covering 99% of current personal injury claims inside and outside the AFFF MDL (115-120k plaintiffs).

MMM payment schedule: $50M in 2026, no payments in 2027, about 20% of payments due in the final two years, aligned to 3M's remaining payment obligations for other legacy settlements. The company takes a $5.8bn charge in Q4 for the present value.
MMM authorized a $6bn common stock repurchase in addition to the $1.5bn remaining under the existing authorization. Call is tomorrow at 8:30am.

The desk argues MMM's distressed multiple and the liability could not coexist. With ITW at 17x EBITDA and MMM at 13x, the desk expects MMM's multiple to expand closer to parity as the liability comes out of enterprise value.

CAR Q3 missed: EBITDA $513mm vs $562mm consensus, EPS $5.15 vs $8.30 consensus, revenue $3.4bn in line with $3.42bn. FY EBITDA is guided to about $850mm vs the prior $800mm-$1bn range. Call at 8:30am with a 9% implied move.

ECG Q3 beat: EPS $1.79 vs $1.31, revenue $1.38bn vs $1.19bn, EBITDA $140mm vs $104mm. Backlog is $5.5bn, up 70% y/y. FY revenue guide raised to $5-5.1bn from $4.5-4.7bn and EBITDA to $485-495mm from $410-425mm. 12% implied move.

FBIN Q3 EPS $1.14 vs $0.74 and EBITDA $197mm vs $186mm, but Q4 guide is well below consensus: EPS $0.19-0.29 vs $0.72 and revenue $925-995mm vs $1.06bn. FY EPS guide $3.20-3.30 vs $3.22-3.52 prior. 6% implied move.

GXO Q3 EPS $0.89 vs $0.86 consensus, revenue $3.59bn vs $3.54bn, adj EBITDA $251mn in line. FY guidance reaffirmed: EPS $2.95-3.15, adj EBITDA $945-965mn, organic revenue growth +4-5%, FCF conversion 30-40%.
IFF Q3 EBITDA $403mm vs $389mm on sales of $1.94bn vs $1.91bn. Low end of FY guidance raised: sales $7.5-7.6bn, EBITDA $1.55-1.6bn. 5% implied move.
MOD fiscal Q2 EPS $1.35 vs $1.45 consensus, EBITDA $136mm vs $141mm, sales $994mm vs $978mm. FY EBITDA $470-500mm. 17% implied move.
MOS Q3 adj EBITDA $324mn vs $343.1mn consensus, adj EPS ($0.19) vs ($0.02), net sales $3.10bn vs $3.04bn, adj EBITDA margin 10.4% vs 11.2%. FY27 capex guided below $1bn vs $1.27bn consensus.
MTW Q3 EPS $0.31 vs $0.20 and sales $614mm vs $577mm. FY EPS guide raised to $0.90-1.25 from $0.80-1.20 and EBITDA to $160-175mm from $150-170mm. 9% implied move.
PRIM Q3 EPS $1.20 vs $0.76 and EBITDA $134mm vs $94mm consensus. FY EBITDA narrowed to $290-310mm and EPS guided to the low end, $2.10-2.25. 14% implied move.
SWIM Q3 sales $182mm vs $181mm and EPS $0.10 vs $0.12. FY revenue guide $605-615mm vs $600-620mm prior, EBITDA $112-118mm vs $110-120mm prior.

CAR Q3 (reported 11/3): EBITDA $513mm vs consensus $562mm, EPS $5.15 vs consensus $8.30, revenue $3.4bn vs consensus $3.42bn. FY EBITDA guide about $850mm vs prior $800mm-$1bn.

ECG Q3 (reported 11/3): EPS $1.79 vs consensus $1.31, revenue $1.38bn vs consensus $1.19bn, EBITDA $140mm vs consensus $104mm. FY revenue guide $5-5.1bn vs prior $4.5-4.7bn, EBITDA $485-495mm vs prior $410-425mm.

FBIN Q3 (reported 11/3): EPS $1.14 vs consensus $0.74, revenue $1.1bn in line, EBITDA $197mm vs consensus $186mm. Q4 EPS guide $0.19-0.29 vs consensus $0.72, revenue $925-995mm vs consensus $1.06bn. FY EPS $3.20-3.30 vs prior $3.22-3.52.

GXO Q3 (reported 11/3): EPS $0.89 vs consensus $0.86, revenue $3.59bn vs consensus $3.54bn, adj EBITDA $251mn in line. FY EPS guide $2.95-3.15 vs consensus $3.02, adj EBITDA $945-965mn vs consensus $954.3mn.
IFF Q3 (reported 11/3): EBITDA $403mm vs consensus $389mm, sales $1.94bn vs consensus $1.91bn, EPS slightly ahead. FY sales $7.5-7.6bn vs prior $7.4-7.6bn, EBITDA $1.55-1.6bn vs prior $1.53-1.6bn.
MOD fiscal Q2 (reported 11/3): EPS $1.35 vs consensus $1.45, sales $994mm vs consensus $978mm, EBITDA $136mm vs consensus $141mm. FY EBITDA $470-500mm, revenue $3.1-3.2bn.

MOS Q3 (reported 11/3): adj EBITDA $324mn vs consensus $343.1mn, adj EPS ($0.19) vs consensus ($0.02), net sales $3.10bn vs consensus $3.04bn. Q4 guide: potash volumes 2.3-2.6mn tons, phosphates volumes 1.3-1.6mn tons. FY capex $1.2bn vs consensus $1.22bn, FY27 capex below $1bn vs consensus $1.27bn.
MTW Q3 (reported 11/3): EPS $0.31 vs consensus $0.20, sales $614mm vs consensus $577mm. FY EPS guide $0.90-1.25 vs prior $0.80-1.20, EBITDA $160-175mm vs prior $150-170mm.
PRIM Q3 (reported 11/3): EPS $1.20 vs consensus $0.76, sales $2bn in line, EBITDA $134mm vs consensus $94mm. FY EBITDA $290-310mm vs prior $275-325mm, EPS $2.10-2.25 vs prior $2.05-2.60.
SWIM Q3 (reported 11/3): sales $182mm vs consensus $181mm, EPS $0.10 vs consensus $0.12. FY revenue $605-615mm vs prior $600-620mm, EBITDA $112-118mm vs prior $110-120mm.
